name: Fuenteheridos (Spain)
description: A red fly half and a hoist half divided horizontally yellow over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuenteheridos (a fountain, a tree on green and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Fuenteheridos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
